_note: DRAFT. Identification hints are general field marks entered for the prototype and must be reviewed against an authoritative WA fish guide before launch. Regulations live in rules.json, never here.

species.name: Australian herring
species.id_tips: Small silvery fish with a large eye; often faint golden-brown speckles along the back.

species.name: Western Australian salmon
species.id_tips: Large, powerful torpedo-shaped fish; greenish back. Easily confused with herring when small — compare size and eye.

species.name: Tailor
species.id_tips: Blue-green back, silver sides, forked tail and sharp teeth — handle carefully.

species.name: King George whiting
species.id_tips: Slender with a pointed snout; brown-bronze spots scattered on the back.

species.name: Southern garfish
species.id_tips: Very slender; lower jaw extends into a long beak; silver side stripe. Rules for this species changed recently — check DPIRD.

species.name: Skipjack trevally
species.id_tips: Silver, fairly deep body, often a yellowish stripe along the side and a dark spot on the gill cover.

species.name: Pink snapper
species.id_tips: Pink body with small blue spots; large adults develop a hump on the head. Demersal scalefish rules apply.

species.name: WA dhufish
species.id_tips: Deep silver-grey body, large mouth, dark bar through the eye. Demersal scalefish rules apply.

species.name: Black bream
species.id_tips: Deep bronze-to-dark body; mainly estuaries and rivers.

species.name: Tarwhine
species.id_tips: Silver with thin golden horizontal lines and yellowish lower fins.

species.name: Flathead (various)
species.id_tips: Flattened head and body, eyes on top, sharp spines on the gill cover — handle carefully.

species.name: Mulloway
species.id_tips: Large silvery-bronze fish with a big mouth and a lateral line that runs into the tail.

species.name: Western blue groper
species.id_tips: Very large wrasse; big males are blue, smaller fish green-brown. Check current rules before taking.

species.name: Southern calamari
species.id_tips: Squid with a fin running most of the body length (cuttlefish have a hard internal shell).
